holder-quote: I am a [Warrior], well, I was before I became a [Lord]. Now I am a [Lord of Battle]. Hardly a unique class.
They see an end to this war. Venith. Call it.
He was gulping down stamina potions. The [Lord of Battle] had stepped back—to survey the battlefield.
Venith Crusland uttered no vows. He stood in the gap and waited for them to come to him.
The first arrows landed around Venith Crusland as he threw himself behind a shattered block of stone.
